title: Glowing hammer
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow aura around hammer -->
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="45%" r="45%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD166" stop-opacity="0.55"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#FFB703" stop-opacity="0.25"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFB703" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="handleGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#C97B2E"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#F4A261"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C97B2E"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="headGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#E8F1F2"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#A9C2C9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7E9AA3"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Big soft glow -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="45" r="46" fill="url(#glow)"/>
  <!-- Handle -->
  <rect x="43" y="44" width="14" height="50" rx="5" fill="url(#handleGrad)"/>
  <!-- Handle highlight stripe -->
  <rect x="47" y="46" width="4" height="46" rx="2" fill="#FFD166" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Handle bottom cap -->
  <rect x="41" y="88" width="18" height="7" rx="3" fill="#8C4F1E"/>
  <!-- Hammer head -->
  <rect x="16" y="18" width="68" height="28" rx="9" fill="url(#headGrad)"/>
  <!-- Head top highlight -->
  <rect x="22" y="21" width="56" height="7" rx="4" fill="#FFFDF5" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- Striking face left -->
  <rect x="10" y="22" width="12" height="20" rx="4" fill="#5C7680"/>
  <!-- Striking face right -->
  <rect x="78" y="22" width="12" height="20" rx="4" fill="#5C7680"/>
  <!-- Striking face glow accents -->
  <rect x="12" y="25" width="4" height="14" rx="2" fill="#FFE29A" opacity="0.7"/>
  <rect x="84" y="25" width="4" height="14" rx="2" fill="#FFE29A" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Wedge/neck connection -->
  <rect x="44" y="44" width="12" height="6" rx="2" fill="#8FA9B1"/>
  <!-- Sparkle stars -->
  <g fill="#FFE29A">
    <polygon points="90,14 92,20 98,20 93,24 95,30 90,26 85,30 87,24 82,20 88,20"/>
    <polygon points="12,70 14,74 18,74 15,77 16,81 12,78 8,81 9,77 6,74 10,74" opacity="0.8"/>
    <polygon points="80,75 81.5,78.5 85,79 82.5,81.5 83,85 80,82.5 77,85 77.5,81.5 75,79 78.5,78.5" opacity="0.7"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small glowing dots -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="62" r="2.5" fill="#FFD166" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="58" r="2" fill="#FFD166" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
